question: Who became the first Indian woman to win two Olympic medals?
solution:
The correct answer is __**PV Sindhu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• PV Sindhu is the first Indian woman to win two Olympic medals.
 
• She won a silver medal in the 2016 Rio Olympics.
 
• She secured a bronze medal in the 2020 Tokyo Olympics.
 
• PV Sindhu is one of India's most successful sports personalities and is celebrated for her achievements in badminton.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Olympics**

 
 
• The Olympics is an international sporting event featuring summer and winter sports competitions.
 
• Athletes from around the world participate in a variety of competitions.
 
• The Olympic Games are held every four years, with the Summer and Winter Games alternating every two years in the four-year period.
 
 
 
• **Badminton**
 
 
• Badminton is a racquet sport played using racquets to hit a shuttlecock across a net.
 
• The game can be played by two opposing players (singles) or two opposing pairs (doubles).
 
• Badminton is a popular sport in many countries, and it is also an Olympic sport.
 
 
 
• **PV Sindhu's Achievements**
 
 
• PV Sindhu has won several medals in various international badminton tournaments including the World Championships and the Commonwealth Games.
 
• She has been awarded the Padma Bhushan, Padma Shri, and the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna award by the Government of India.
 
• Sindhu's achievements have inspired many young athletes in India to pursue sports professionally.
